verdict.rationale: The Venture & Growth Tech page states the firm supports growth companies 'from fundraising to exit'. It has a dedicated M&A section covering acquisitions, sales and transfers, with a named exit reference (Comeen's acquisition by LumApps), and it mentions financing work 'from seed capital to IPOs'. This is backed by a Chambers Band 1 VC ranking. Missing for 10: a dedicated page or case studies documenting IPO/public-offering experience for venture-backed companies, more than one named exit deal, and independent corroboration of exit-specific track record.
